options.help: With -c/--continue <name>: if no session matches the name, create a new session with that title and proceed (instead of failing with a not-found error). Programmatic callers that want 'send to this named thread, making it if needed'.

options.help: Maximum tool-calling iterations per conversation turn (default: 500, or agent.max_turns in config)

options.name: run_budget
options.help: Optional wall-clock budget in seconds for each conversation run. Also configurable as agent.run_budget_seconds in config.yaml. Intended for one-shot/eval invocations with a hard ceiling.
